explanation: Compared against erdosproblems.com/789 and Korsky's proof claim (forum): h(n) ≫ √(n log log n / log n). The page does not yet list this, but a formal proof in this file's lineage is linked, and it improves the listed Erdős–Choi bound. h(n) (subsetSumThreshold) is the maximal m such that every n-set A ⊆ ℤ has B ⊆ A, |B| ≥ m, in which equal sums of nonempty subsets force equal cardinalities. The distinct-elements reading is consistent with Erdős's random-α construction, which would fail with repetition. Faithful.
